content: Knowledge distillation BIBREF12, BIBREF13 differs from the other discussed approaches: the smaller student model may be parametrized differently from the bigger teacher model, affording more modeling freedom. Teaching a student model to match the soft output label distributions from a larger model alongside the hard ground-truth distribution works well for many tasks, such as machine translation BIBREF27 and language modeling BIBREF28.
